units.title: Window stops or guards required; exceptions.
units.full_text:
(a) The owner and/or management company of a rental property, which is two stories or taller, shall provide, install, and maintain a window stop or window guard on each exterior window of a type determined as acceptable by the Buildings, Safety Engineering, and Environmental Department for the following:

(1) The windows of each dwelling unit more than 72 inches above finished grade or other surface below on the exterior of the building where a child or children under ten years of age reside;

(2) The windows of all common areas; and

(3) The windows of each dwelling unit more than 72 inches above finished grade or other surface below on the exterior of the building where the tenant requests installation of such stops or guards.

(b) Subsection (a) of this section does not apply to windows that provide access to a fire escape or to windows that are a required means of egress from a dwelling unit.
